preconditions.description: The number of test cases T is between 1 and 10 inclusive.
For each test case, the number of ingredient types N is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= 10000 for a in A)
preconditions.description: Each ingredient quantity A_i is between 1 and 10,000 inclusive.
The list of quantities A contains exactly N integers.

postconditions.expression: output_lines == [str(-1) if any(a < 2 for a in A) else str(sum(A) - min(A) + 2) for A in test_cases_A]
postconditions.description: For each test case, if any ingredient has less than 2 units, output -1. Otherwise, output the sum of all quantities minus the minimum quantity plus 2, which represents the worst-case picks needed to guarantee 2 of each type.
